scope: round8, one sample per condition, no generalized quality claim

patterns.prompt: One locked-camera documentary interview take from the supplied frame, same woman, face, hair, apron, background and warm window light. Preserve the reference skin texture without retouching. She remains seated with settled shoulders, hands resting in her lap below frame. Her eyes stay on one interviewer just camera-right; an occasional natural blink and small mouth movements accompany speech. Understated matter-of-fact delivery. Begin speaking immediately, without a preparatory smile or breath: "we use CREW now. everyone puts their availability on their phone." Finish the sentence once, then close her lips and listen quietly. No shoulder shrug, no sideways glance, no head sway, no exaggerated eyebrows, no zoom, no cut, no music, no captions, no logos.
patterns.hypothesis: Same concise interview prompt and generated identity reference as Kling v2; screen native H3 for speech, skin and settled blocking. Resolution and model seeds differ. Provider expansion is recorded if returned.
patterns.finding: Both product sentences transcribe correctly, ending at 6.26s. Broad smiles, several closed-eye expressions and eyebrow changes conflict with restrained direction. Reference bakery, apron and recognizable face remain in sampled frames. Native output is 1344x768 at 24fps, with container duration 6.592s despite requesting 6s. A correct transcript is not proof of lip sync. Reject for this restrained interview, not all possible H3 people shots.
patterns.next_action: Prefer incumbent or test simpler positive performance direction

patterns.prompt: One candid creator take from this starting frame. Same woman, dark curly hair, forest-green shirt, white desk and soft window light. Preserve her natural facial asymmetry and existing skin texture. She looks into the camera and says in relaxed English: "I remember the idea. I forget what I promised to do." She briefly opens her right hand palm-up above the desk on the second sentence, then rests it back on the desk. Shoulders stay relaxed; eyes attend to the camera with an occasional blink. Small rueful expression, conversational rather than sales delivery. Cloth moves with the forearm. Locked phone camera. Finish once, lips close, hands resting, same framing and light. Quiet room tone without music; no captions, logos, cut or beauty retouching.
patterns.hypothesis: Test one motivated hand gesture rather than multiple micro-expression instructions. New line; old Veo frame supplies identity, not a controlled speech baseline.
patterns.finding: Correct new hook line, ending at 5.10s. Clear palm-up gesture and recognizable starting face; warm smile changes into a rueful expression. Gesture starts in the first sentence rather than the requested second; the 1.42s transcript gap slows the hook. Hands return by the end. Sampled visible hand shape is plausible; fast finger transitions and lip sync are unmeasured. Selected 0–5.5s for this casual concept; do not advertise it as indistinguishable from real footage.
patterns.next_action: Reuse for compatible scene; verify new source and output

patterns.prompt: One continuous product shot from the supplied macro frame. Preserve this exact ivory circular recorder, its single black circular top button, tiny green light, low cylindrical sidewall and matte ceramic surface. The recorder stays stationary on the charcoal table. Slowly pull the camera straight back to reveal the whole recorder, finishing with it on the right half and empty charcoal space at left. Stable soft light from upper left, unchanged exposure and color, physically coherent reflection. Camera eases to a complete stop by five seconds and holds the final composition for one second. No object rotation, new buttons, labels, text, people or scene cuts. Quiet studio room tone, no music or speech.
patterns.hypothesis: Test whether a supplied object frame plus one camera action protects geometry and creates a usable settled exit for the next shot.
patterns.finding: Single button, indicator, ivory rim and cylindrical body remain coherent in sampled frames. Camera pulls back and creates left-side space. The reviewed 5.5s frame has a usable settled composition; the preceding frame differs by 0.69 RGB MAE/255. Source image comes from an earlier Kling-generated fictional object, not a real product design. Selected for the reveal and as the continuation reference.
patterns.next_action: Reuse for compatible scene; verify new source and output

A next human test should change observable performance direction or use the incumbent, rather than buy another expansion toggle.

patterns.prompt: Continue this product shot from the supplied opening frame. The same ivory circular recorder remains stationary on the same charcoal tabletop, on the right of the frame. Lock the camera at this exact position, angle, focus and exposure. Preserve the one black top button, tiny green indicator, ceramic surface, circular rim and solid cylindrical sidewall. Stable soft light from upper left, only a very faint natural shift in the highlight on the ceramic. Hold the product and its shadow perfectly settled; keep the left side empty. End in the supplied final composition. No camera move, object rotation, new controls, text, people, speech or music.
patterns.hypothesis: Use reviewed exit frame as both endpoints for a settled product continuation; compare H3 and Kling on shape, color, frame seams and middle-frame drift. Repeated image is intentional; subtle light only.
patterns.finding: Actual previous-shot exit used for both input endpoints. Stable stationary object and low middle-frame drift in this simple case. Boundary RGB MAE 2.1308/255; mean-luma shift 1.5995/255. Cheaper continuation candidate ($0.30 estimated) than Kling; slight boundary tone change remains. Exact repeated endpoints do not imply all intermediate frames are identical.
patterns.next_action: Reuse for compatible scene; verify new source and output
